construct: autonomous discovery against a fixed, public, independently enforced scorecard
design_correction: Independence is authority separation, not secrecy.

baseline.strategy: free-form search with full scorecard visibility

primary_endpoint: unique externally verified public score dimensions improved per arm
duplicate_rule: Multiple candidates improving the same dimension count once.

other_verdicts.OUTCOME_TRACE_NO_GAIN: Outcome Trace ties or loses to baseline
other_verdicts.INSUFFICIENT_SEARCH_GAIN: Outcome Trace leads but misses the preregistered minimum or margin

power_control: Before model contact, prove the starting substrate scores 0/8 and each public score dimension is independently reachable by a one-file consequence-level reference fix.
stopping_rule: One prospective tournament. No scorecard edits, oracle edits, prompt tuning, budget changes, or reruns after observing results.
